751-4289-7175.description:
Cast Shrieking Drake by paying {U}.
When Shrieking Drake enters, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Shrieking Drake by tapping it, adding {U}.
Resolve the Shrieking Drake ability, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

2301-4279-4699--216.easyPrerequisites:
The undying creature doesn't have a +1/+1 counter on it.
Your life total is 2 or higher.
2301-4279-4699--216.description:
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing the undying creature.
When the creature dies, Overgrowth Elemental, Abzan Ascendancy and the undying creature's undying ability trigger.
Resolve the Overgrowth Elemental trigger, causing you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Abzan Ascendancy ability, creating a 1/1 Spirit creature token.
Resolve the undying trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on any creature and drawing a card.
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Overgrowth Elemental triggers, causing you to gain 1 life 
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on the undying creature and drawing a card.
Repeat.

2645-3430-3861-5475.easyPrerequisites: Forensic Researcher doesn't have summoning sickness.
2645-3430-3861-5475.description:
Activate Orzhov Basilica by tapping it, adding {W}{W}{W}{B}{B}{B} due to Nyxbloom Ancient
Activate Forensic Researcher by tapping it, untapping Orzhov Basilica
Activate Staff of Domination's third ability by paying {3} and tapping it, untapping Forensic Researcher.
Activate Staff of Domination's first ability by paying {1}, untapping it.
Repeat.

requires.n: Zombie Creature castable for one colored mana

728-3249-3755-7968--206.easyPrerequisites: Grimgrin does not have summoning sickness.
728-3249-3755-7968--206.description:
Activate Grimgrin's ability from Elven Chorus by tapping Grimgrin, adding one mana.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the zombie castable for one mana, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Grimgrin's ability from Elven Chorus by tapping Grimgrin, adding one mana.
Activate Havengul Lich by paying {1}, allowing you to cast the zombie castable for one mana from your graveyard this turn.
Cast that zombie spell from your graveyard by paying it mana cost.
When you cast that zombie or when it enters, Diregraf Colossus triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the creature token, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

uses.n: Fable of the Mirror-Breaker // Reflection of Kiki-Jiki

2105-2215-3337.easyPrerequisites: Reflection of Kiki-Jiki does not have summoning sickness.
2105-2215-3337.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block at least one creature you control.
2105-2215-3337.description:
Activate Reflection of KIki-Jiki by paying {1} and tapping it, creating a token copy of Combat Celebrant with haste.
Declare the Combat Celebrant token and, if needed, an additional creature an opponent cannot block as attackers, choosing to exert Combat Celebrant as it attacks.
When you attack, the token Combat Celebrant triggers, untapping all other creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
When you deal combat damage, Grim Hireling triggers, creating at least one Treasure token.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding one mana.
Repeat.

1981-2415-3899-6719.easyPrerequisites:
You control another creature.
You have 2 or more life.
1981-2415-3899-6719.description:
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing a creature.
When the creature dies, Havoc Jester triggers, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Dazzling Angel triggers, causing you to gain life
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability.
Repeat.

277-4094-4365-6441-7942.easyPrerequisites: At least two loyalty counters on Kaya.
277-4094-4365-6441-7942.description:
Activate Kaya's second loyalty ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, causing you to double any tokens you create this turn.
Activate Saurian Explorer by paying {6}, creating eight tapped New Planet tokens due to the three token doublers.
When the New Planet tokens enter, Tiller Engine triggers eight times, untapping the New Planet tokens.
Activate six of the tokens by tapping them, adding {6}.
Repeat from step 2

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Radiant Solar
as a copy of Radiant Solar

670-1619-4264-4865.easyPrerequisites:
You have a way to cause a creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
You are not currently venturing in a dungeon.
670-1619-4264-4865.description:
Put any nontoken creature onto the battlefield.
When the creature enters, Radiant Solar, Altered Ego and Vesuvan Shapeshifter each trigger.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger, causing you to venture into Tomb of Annihilation and into the Trapped Entry room, causing each player to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Altered Ego trigger, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Radiant Solar.
Resolve the Vesuvan Shapeshifter trigger, venturing into the Cradle of the Death God room, creating a 4/4 legendary The Atropal creature token and completing Tomb of Annihilation.
If you control two or more The Atropal tokens, put all but one into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Sefris' second ability triggers, returning Radiant Solar from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
670-1619-4264-4865.notes: If you are currently venturing in a dungeon when starting the combo, you can complete the dungeon and then use Sefris' second ability to put a creature onto the battlefield to start the combo.

215-4785-5711.description:
Activate Fanatic of Rhonas by tapping it, adding {G}{G}{G}{G}
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Fanatic of Rhonas from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Fanatic of Rhonas by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

470-1560-3519.notablePrerequisites:
The total power of creatures you control is at least 10 plus Ghalta's commander tax.
You control at least one additional creature.
470-1560-3519.description:
Cast Ghalta from the command zone by paying {G}{G}.
Defiler of Vigor triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Activate Food Chain by exiling Ghalta, adding thirteen {G} that can only be spent to cast creature spells.
Choose to return Ghalta from exile to the command zone.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: without summoning sickness and without a -1/-1 counter on it

1887-3099-4762-7704.description:
Activate Leyline of Abundance by paying {6}{G}{G}, putting four +1/+1 counters on each creature you control due to Doc Samson and Vorinclex.
Activate Devoted Druid's first ability by tapping it, adding {G}.
Leyline of Abundance triggers, adding {G}.
Activate Devoted Druid's second ability by putting a -1/-1 counter on it, untapping Devoted Druid.
Repeat from step 2 three additional times.
Repeat from step 1.

1394-2060-4029-5231-7038.description:
Play Power Depot, which will enter with a +1/+1 counter on it due to its modular ability
Cast Toph either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {2}{R}{G} plus commander tax if applicable.
When Toph enters, it triggers, earthbending Power Depot and putting a number of +1/+1 counters on Power Depot equal to the mana spent to cast Toph, increased by Benevolent Hydra.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Power Depot.
When Power Depot dies, its modular ability and Toph trigger.
Resolve the modular trigger, putting the +1/+1 counters that were on Power Depot onto Crystalline Crawler, increased by Benevolent Hydra.
Resolve the Toph trigger, returning Power Depot from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped. Power Depot will enter with a +1/+1 counter on it due to its modular ability
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Toph. Choose to return Toph from your graveyard to the command zone.
Activate Crystalline Crawler by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {R/G}.
Repeat step 9 until you have enough mana to cast Toph.
Repeat from step 2.

3220-6797-7084.easyPrerequisites:
You control a land.
You control another nonland creature.
3220-6797-7084.description:
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing another nonland creature.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land you control.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing the earthbent land.
When the land dies, Golgari Germination and Beifong's Bounty Hunters trigger.
Resolve the Beifong's Bounty Hunters trigger, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Golgari Germination trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Repeat.

4605-4681-5256-7261.description:
Cast Chord of Calling by paying at most {5}{G}{G}{G}, searching your library for Karmic Guide and putting it onto the battlefield.
When Karmic Guide enters, it and Preston trigger.
Resolve the Karmic Guide trigger, returning an applicable target from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Holding priority, activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Karmic Guide.
Resolve the Preston trigger, creating a token copy of Karmic Guide that is a 0/1 Illusion.
When the Karmic Guide token enters, it triggers, returning Karmic Guide from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

11-121-3617-7089.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block and kill Fire Lord Azula
11-121-3617-7089.description:
Declare Fire Lord Azula as an attacker, triggering its firebending ability, adding {R}{R}.
Holding priority, cast Time Walk by paying its mana cost.
Fire Lord Azula's second ability triggers, copying Time Walk.
Holding priority, cast Narset's Reversal by paying {U}{U}, targeting the original Time Walk spell.
Fire Lord Azula's second ability triggers, copying Narset's Reversal, targeting the original Narset's Reversal.
Resolve the copy of Narset's Reversal, causing you to copy Narset's Reversal targeting the original Time Walk spell, and then return the original Narset's Reversal to your hand.
Resolve the copy of Narset's Reversal, copying Time Walk and returning the original Time Walk to your hand.
Resolve both copies of Time Walk from steps 3 and 7, causing you to take two extra turns after this one.
Repeat during your second extra turn.

2099-2793-5089-6459.description:
If Karn has exactly one loyalty counter on it, activate its first loyalty ability by putting a loyalty counter on it.
Activate Sarcatog by sacrificing Ugin's Nexus. Ugin's Nexus will be exiled instead of being put into your graveyard due to its replacement effect, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Move to your next turn.
Activate Aetheric Amplifier by paying {4} and tapping it, doubling the number of counters on Karn.
Activate Karn's second loyalty ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, returning Ugin's Nexus from exile to your hand.
Cast Ugin's Nexus by paying {5}.
Repeat from step 2.

2292-4681-6981.description:
Cast Perigee Beckoner for its warp cost by paying {1}{B}.
When Perigee Beckoner enters, it triggers, targeting Karmic Guide.
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Perigee Beckoner.
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Karmic Guide.
When Karmic Guide dies, it triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Karmic Guide enters, it triggers, returning Perigee Beckoner from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Perigee Beckoner enters, it triggers, targeting Karmic Guide.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability from step 4.
Repeat from step 3.

3976-4406-6853.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
3976-4406-6853.description:
Cast Chance for Glory by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one and to lose the game at the beginning of that turn's end step.
Activate Magar by paying {1}{B}{R}, noting Chance for Glory and putting it face down on the battlefield as a 3/3 creature.
Activate Magar by paying {1}{B}{R}, noting Day's Undoing and putting it face down on the battlefield as a 3/3 creature.
During your next turn, deal combat damage to an opponent using the face down creatures that have Chance for Glory and Day's Undoing noted. The creatures trigger.
Resolve the first trigger, casting a copy of Chance for Glory without paying its mana cost. Resolve the copy, causing you to take an extra turn after this one and to lose the game at the beginning of that turn's end step.
Resolve the second trigger, casting a copy of Day's Undoing without paying its mana cost. Resolve the copy, causing you to end the turn. This will prevent the Chance for Glory trigger from causing you to lose the game.
Repeat from step 3.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with an indestructible counter on it

5619-5957-6527.easyPrerequisites: You have three or less opponents.
5619-5957-6527.description:
Activate Myojin of Roaring Blades by removing an indestructible counter from it.
Holding priority, cast Sway of the Stars by paying {8}{U}{U}, causing each player to shuffle their hand, graveyard and all permanents they own into their library, then causing each player to draw seven cards and set their life total to 7.
Resolve the Myojin of Roaring Blades ability, dealing 7 damage to each of up to three opponents.
Each opponent loses the game due to having 0 life.

2584-3362-3839.notablePrerequisites: You have enough mana to cast Changeling Hero.
2584-3362-3839.description:
Cast Changeling Hero by paying {3}{R}.
When Changeling Hero enters the battlefield, it and Pandemonium trigger.
Resolve the Changeling Hero trigger, exiling Bladewing until Changeling Hero leaves the battlefield.
Resolve the Pandemonium trigger, dealing damage to Changeling Hero equal to Changeling Hero's power.
Changeling Hero dies as a state-based action due to having 0 or less toughness.
When Changeling Hero dies, it triggers, returning Bladewing from exile to the battlefield.
When Bladewing enters the battlefield, it and Pandemonium trigger.
Resolve the Pandemonium trigger, dealing damage equal to Bladewing's power to any target.
Resolve the Bladewing trigger, returning Changeling Hero from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.n: Extus, Oriq Overlord // Awaken the Blood Avatar

2091-4558-5231-5913.notablePrerequisites: Your opponents control at least nine tapped lands.
2091-4558-5231-5913.description:
Cast Mana Geyser by paying {3}{R}{R}.
Extus triggers, returning Pinnacle Monk from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve Mana Geyser, adding {R} for each tapped land your opponents control.
Cast Pinnacle Monk by paying its mana cost.
When Pinnacle Monk enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Mana Geyser from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Pinnacle Monk, adding {R}.
Repeat.

2092-2307-4499.notablePrerequisites: Agatha of the Vile Cauldron has power 2 or greater.
2092-2307-4499.description:
Activate Emiel the Blessed by paying {1}, blinking Corsair Captain.
When Corsair Captain enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a Treasure artifact token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

2816-5711.notablePrerequisites:
Umbral Mantle attached to Fanatic of Rhonas.
Fanatic of Rhonas does not have summoning sickness.
You control a creature with power 4 or greater.
2816-5711.description:
Activate Fanatic of Rhonas's second ability by tapping it, adding {G}{G}{G}{G}.
Activate Fanatic of Rhonas using the ability from Umbral Mantle by paying {3} and untapping it, giving it +2/+2 until end of turn.
Repeat.

116-2569-4264.notablePrerequisites:
Altered Ego is a copy of Kiora's Follower.
Kiora's Follower and Altered Ego do not have summoning sickness.
116-2569-4264.description:
Activate Kiora's Follower by tapping it.
When Kiora's Follower becomes tapped, Judge of Currents triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Resolve Kiora's Follower's ability from step 1, untapping Altered Ego.
Activate Altered Ego by tapping it.
When Altered Ego becomes tapped, Judge of Currents triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Resolve Altered Ego's ability from step 4, untapping Kiora's Follower.
Repeat.

2066-2757-4824.easyPrerequisites: Fertile Ground attached to a basic land you control.
2066-2757-4824.description:
Activate the basic land with Fertile Ground attached by tapping it, adding at least {1}.
Fertile Ground triggers, adding {U}.
Activate Earthcraft by tapping Soliton, untapping the basic land.
Activate Soliton by paying {U}, untapping it.
Repeat.
If the basic land is an Island, you may add mana of any color using Fertile Ground's trigger, and you may infinitely repeat steps 3-4 with any other basic land you control.

1558-2048-3592-4840.description:
Activate Planar Bridge by paying {8} and tapping it, causing you to search your library for Myr Battlesphere and put it onto the battlefield.
When Myr Battlesphere enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating four 1/1 Myr artifact creature tokens.
Activate Time Sieve by tapping it, sacrificing Myr Battlesphere and the four Myr tokens, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Activate Epitaph Golem by paying {2}, putting Myr Battlesphere on the bottom of your library from your graveyard.
Repeat each turn.

643-2060-2893-4482-4690.notablePrerequisites: Fertilid has at least one +1/+1 counter on it.
643-2060-2893-4482-4690.description:
Activate Fertilid by paying {1}{G} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, causing you to search your library for a basic land card and put it onto the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters the battlefield, Phylath's second ability triggers twice, putting four +1/+1 counters on Fertilid and Crystalline Crawler.
Activate Crystalline Crawler's first ability twice by removing two +1/+1 counters from it, adding {1}{G}.
Repeat.

224-433-1373-2653-4482.notablePrerequisites:
Llanowar Scout does not have summoning sickness.
You have a land card in hand that enters the battlefield untapped.
224-433-1373-2653-4482.description:
Activate Llanowar Scout by tapping it, putting a land from your hand onto the battlefield.
The land enters the battlefield, triggering Nissa and Retreat to Coralhelm twice.
Resolve both Nissa triggers, adding {R}{G}.
Resolve both Retreat to Coralhelm triggers, untapping Llanowar Scout and choosing either to untap another creature or scry 1.
Activate a land by tapping it, adding at least {1}.
Activate Mina and Denn by paying {R}{G} and returning a land from the battlefield to your hand, giving a creature trample until end of turn.
Repeat.

415-3059-4475.description:
At the beginning of your upkeep, Xathrid Demon triggers, causing you to sacrifice Malignus and causing each opponent to lose life equal to Malignus's power.
At the beginning of your end step, Wound Reflection triggers, causing each opponent to lose life equal to the amount of life they lost this turn.
Each opponent loses the game due to having zero or less life.

1355-2645.notablePrerequisites: Sanctum Weaver does not have summoning sickness. You control at least five enchantments.
1355-2645.description:
Activate Sanctum Weaver by tapping it, adding at least five mana of any color.
Activate Staff of Domination's third ability by paying {3} and tapping it, untapping Sanctum Weaver.
Activate Staff of Domination's first ability by paying {1}, untapping it.
Repeat.
1355-2645.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you may use it to activate Staff of Domination's other abilities.

1785-1926-2178-5010.notablePrerequisites:
Thornbite Staff attached to Soldevi Adnate.
"Human" or "Warrior" chosen with Species Specialist.
1785-1926-2178-5010.description:
Activate Soldevi Adnate by tapping it and sacrificing Golgari Thug, adding {B}{B}.
Soldevi Adnate, Golgari Thug, and Species Specialist trigger.
Resolve the Soldevi Adnate trigger, untapping it.
Resolve the Golgari Thug trigger, putting it from your graveyard on top of your library.
Resolve the Species Specialist trigger, drawing Golgari Thug from your library.
Cast Golgari Thug by paying {1}{B}.
Repeat.

2506-4846.description:
Cast Worldgorger Dragon, triggering Molten Echoes and Worldgorger Dragon's ETBs; stack the triggers to resolve in that order.
Resolve Molten Echoes' trigger, creating a token copy of Worldgorger Dragon and triggering its ETB.
Float as much mana as you want in response to the token's ETB trigger.
The token's effect resolves, exiling everything else you control, including the original Worldgorger Dragon.
Resolve the original Worldgorger Dragon's LTB with no effect, then resolve the ETB trigger of the original Worldgorger Dragon, exiling the token copy.
Resolve token Worldgorger Dragon's LTB trigger, returning everything it exiled to the battlefield under your control.
Name Dragons as Molten Echoes enters the battlefield.
Repeat the loop from the top for infinite mana.
Repeat this process until you have infinite mana.
The loop can broken by naming a different creature type as Molten Echoes enters the battlefield.
